name: Windermere
quote: "Windermere" is thought to translate as "Winand or Vinand's lake" ... 'mere', meaning 'lake' or 'pool'

name: Odolena Voda
quote: The name means "Odolen's water" ... named after Knight Odolen ... refers to the sufficient water in the area

name: New Wells
quote: Austrian settlers referred to the community as Neu Wels, after the city in Austria, which was later Americanized to New Wells

name: Spoerkelnbruch
quote: Vermutlicher Namensgeber ist der Faulbaum ... Bruch ist eine alte Bezeichnung für ein Moor oder Feuchtgebiet

name: Clairmarais
quote: l'oïl clair + maresc : le « marais aux eaux claires »

name: L'Ile-Saint-Denis
quote: L'Île-Saint-Denis doit son nom à l'abbaye de Saint-Denis ... qui eut seigneurie sur l'île centrale

name: Ostrvo
quote: "Ostrovo" means "island" in Serbian. This name originates from the fact that Ostrovo is located on former Danube island

name: Veliki Otok

name: Pont-Pean
quote: le toponyme Pont-Péan peut donc signifier « pont paysan » ou « pont construit ou possédé par un dénommé Péan »

name: Saint-Fargeau-Ponthierry

name: Ennerdale Bridge
quote: The name Ennerdale means 'Anund's valley' ... cross-influenced by 'Ehen', the name of the local river

name: Dol pri Ljubljani
quote: The name is derived from the Slovene common noun dol 'small valley'

name: Spodnji Velovlek
quote: The name Spodnji Velovlek literally means 'lower Velovlek'

name: Germigny-sous-Coulombs
quote: Du latin germinare, « germer », du latin germinius, « rejet (botanique) » ou « rejeton, progéniture ». Coulombs fait référence à Coulombs-en-Valois
